title: Fixes DNA vault being constructable half-in a wall.
author: ArcaneMusic

changes.text: the BSA cannot be built half-into a wall.
building the DNA vault and BSA points to the tiles blocking it's construction.

title: Generic surgical operations now have unique radial icons
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: Generic surgical operations now have unique surgery radial icons

title: Vendors in audit log are no longer prefixed with "the"
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: Audit log formats vendors without "the"

title: Buffs blue and purple raptors a bit, and fixes chasm immunity bugs
author: SmArtKar

changes.text: Blue raptors had their HP increased from 220 to 300
Purple raptors now automatically start flying if the owner is about to fall into a chasm.
Fixed 2 exploits which would render you immune to falling down a specific chasm.

title: Gives subsystem controllers a bitfield def to make vv easier, renames their flags var
author: LemonInTheDark

changes.text: Subsystem flags are now displayed as flags instead of raw numbers in vv

title: Corrects shoving someone into another person sending the "you shoved" message to the person who was shoved into
author: lelandkemble

changes.text: Shoving someone into another person no longer sends the "you shoved" message to the person who was shoved into

title: Add blood splatter events to a few places
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: More places causes the "splattered with blood" mood event

title: Monkey Dust no longer can provide permanent stun immunity
author: lelandkemble

changes.text: Monkey dust now properly removes anti-stun properties when its imbiber is no longer a monkey

title: Adds a 0 point quirk that turns your body into a recovered crewmember (effectively) on DNRing
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: Adds Thanatorenasia, a 0 point neutral quirk that turns your body into a "recovered crewmember" if you choose to DNR - meaning if revived, any ghost could take control of it
Refactored "ghostrol on revive" behavior a fair bit, report any oddities with it / the spawners menu

title: Removes a double space on to_chat for spray can
author: FalloutFalcon

changes.text: removed extra space on spraying an atmos machine with spray can

title: RTG code refresh
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: Cleaned up RTG code. Admins can now VV them easier. If you come across a ruin on Lavaland or in space that uses them and see any odd behavior, report it as an issue.

title: Fixes friendly wisps, wizard orbiting gravity anomalies & tesla periphery balls being disabled on shuttle transit
author: lelandkemble

changes.text: Friendly wisps, wizard gravity balls, & tesla periphery balls are no longer disabled due to shuttle transit

title: Fixes vitals display not respecting power upon being placed
author: Iajret

changes.text: fixed vitals display not respecting APCs power when you attach it to a wall

title: Makes vitals display available in ancient lathes
author: Iajret

changes.text: Vitals display can be printed in ancient lathes

title: Barcode scanner now lets you check books out
author: JohnFulpWillard

changes.text: The Curator's barcode scanner now lets you check books out.
The library console can no longer borrow books for an infinite amount of time.

title: Adds support for gags underclothing / Uses it to make them look less jank on lizards
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: Some undergarmants will now use a generic replacement on lizard body shapes that fit more appropriately
Refactored how undergarmants generate their icons, report any oddities with that

title: Apply height filters to electrocution animation
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: The skeleton from being shocked matches your height

title: Vended glasses in the Beach Bar virtual domain count towards domain completion when drank
author: lelandkemble

changes.text: Glasses that were in the vending machine now still count for the completion of the Beach Bar virtual domain

title: [NO GBP] Corrects two issues with goodies and the ordering console.
author: ArcaneMusic

changes.text: Cargo goodies are now visible in the ordering and request consoles.

title: Gorillas can pick up kittens
author: Jacquerel

changes.text: Nonhuman mobs with hands can now pick up other mobs that are smaller than them and can usually be picked up

title: Boxcutting wrapped packages returns less wrap
author: cebutris

changes.text: Fixed an oversight with package wrapping

title: Adds a boolean type to circuits
author: Y0SH1M4S73R

changes.text: Many circuit components have had ports that effectively act as boolean inputs or outputs converted into a new boolean datatype.

title: Fix soup bowl looping not working
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: Drinking soup will loop until it's empty or you cancel it (as it used to)

title: carbon_stripping.dm uses defines instead of magic numbers
author: SunriseOverYourHead

changes.text: Uses defines instead of magic numbers on carbon_stripping.dm

title: Legacy changes
author: KOCMODECAHTHUK

changes.text: Изменены пути внутри гитхаба к инструментам

title: Classic Cocktails 2: The liqueurening
author: RusselNotSCP

changes.text: Added three new liqueurs, with bottles available in the booze-o-mat.
Added 15 new cocktails that use the aforementioned liqueurs.

title: The random supply drop event can now contain goodies and will not runtime.
author: ArcaneMusic

changes.text: supply packs can now be spawned using containers different than a crate.
The Random Supply Drop event can now spawn their items as opposed to runtiming.

title: Guards against shapechanging while being deleted
author: vinylspiders

changes.text: fixes an issue where casting spells after your mob gets deleted can leave you in a permanently bugged state.

title: Adds a balloon alert to Slime Link messages
author: Absolucy

changes.text: Slime Link messages now notify listeners with a balloon alert.

title: Fixes posters rolling up when deleted
author: SyncIt21

changes.text: tearing a poster while placing it only creates a shred poster on the wall but won't place a new one in hand

title: Immobile mobile defibrillator mounts are no longer called mobile
author: lelandkemble

changes.text: Immobile mobile defibrillator mounts are no longer called mobile

title: Fixes being unable to use tape to secure limbs
author: lelandkemble

changes.text: Tape can now secure prosthetic limbs again

title: Aligns medisim docking doors with evac doors
author: Rhials

changes.text: The medisim shuttle docking port now aligns properly with most evac terminals.

title: Snow cabin fake holy wand keeps its sprite
author: lelandkemble

changes.text: Snow Cabin fake healing wand now holds on to its sprite

title: Fixes screen_shake_darken still shaking the screen
author: LemonInTheDark

changes.text: the darken screen shake preference will no longer shake your screen underneath the fullscreen overlay

title: Fixes being unable to put a horn in a clown car
author: lelandkemble

changes.text: You can put a horn in a clown car

title: Adds a cargo shuttle upgrade for plastic flaps and air refills.
author: ArcaneMusic

changes.text: Centcom is now offering the ability to purchase airflow blocking plastic flaps, and the ability to refill the cargo shuttle with air for the low, low installation fee of 8,000 credits. Inquire today under the "Imports" category!

title: Hallucination delusions copy lighting underlays
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: Hallucinating yourself as another mob will no longer disable all of your light sources

title: Moves lung scanning code out of `healthscan`
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: Health analyzer lung reports are appended by the lung organs rather than at the bottom of the readout

title: Fix some signal registration issues with arm implants
author: TealSeer

changes.text: fixed a few bugs related to arm implant surgery

title: Adds missing bitflags to bitfield defines
author: TealSeer

changes.text: added missing bitflags to bitfield defines

title: Fixes 2 sink frame bugs
author: SyncIt21

changes.text: you cannot install infinite water recyclers in the sink frame
you can attach sink frames to walls in most cases regardless of what's on the wall(except when there is already a light fixture, camera or another sink)

title: General maintenance for random chemical reactions
author: SyncIt21

changes.text: random recipes like metalgen & secret sause have been refactored. Please report bugs on github

title: Replaces Changeling's stat panel entry
author: JohnFulpWillard

changes.text: Changeling's stat panel entry has been moved to the HUD & Antag panel. Also added some extra explanations on how Changelings work in there.

title: Replaces the Space Suit stat panel entry
author: JohnFulpWillard

changes.text: The stat panel entry for space suits has been replaced with the HUD element. You can now hover over it to see exact cell percentage, and click it to turn the regulator on, while it'll also display when it's off.

title: Embed removal during surgery fix
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: You can remove embeds during surgery

title: Ensures heads update sprite on organ movement
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: Gibbed heads don't look debrained despite having a brain

title: Fixes a race condition with the slow shuttle station trait
author: vinylspiders

changes.text: fixes an issue where the 'slow shuttle' station trait can sometimes not be applied properly

title: Hallucination delusions copy lighting underlays
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: Hallucinating yourself as another mob will no longer disable all of your light sources

title: Removes cloning (lab)
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: "Cloning Lab" is no longer a traitor codeword.

title: Adds a space and changes punctuation in the thanatorenasia ghost offer dialog
author: lelandkemble

changes.text: Changed spacing an punctuation in thanatorenasia offer to ghosts

title: When forcing an earthquake, admins can now choose its location
author: DATA-xPUNGED

changes.text: When forcing an earthquake, admins can now pick their precise position on the station.

title: Installing/moving windoor electronics only happens after the do-after
author: Hatterhat

changes.text: Installing electronics into windoors/interior doors only moves the electronics out of your hand on a successful installation.

title: Prevents infinite plasteel from girders
author: lelandkemble

changes.text: You can no longer create infinite plasteel with girders

title: Academy redone
author: Yobrocharlie

changes.text: Added the academy back, its now a fetch quest.

title: We made psyker hunters playable but now we need to make psyker hunters playable
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: The Psyker hunter ship now has a bandolier and two holsters for their shotgun and revolvers, as well as some backup knives.
The Psyker hunter ship now has a box of bandages and an emergency medkit.
All Psyker hunters now spawn with a headset set to a shared frequency.
Psyker headsets now prevent their echolocation from being disabled due to deafness.
Psyker hunters now spawn with flavorful eyewear. The Psyker Seer now spawns with the thermal monocle (which was previously on the ship).
Gore will now heal Psykers.

title: Mob height is stored in DNA
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: Height is now an element of DNA, meaning it can be changed via genetics or radstorms and is carried between genetic copies (Changlings, etc)

title: Fixes stack items not being refunded by failed heretic summon rituals
author: SmArtKar

changes.text: Fixed stack items not being refunded by failed heretic summon rituals

title: Fixes parallax runtiming horribly whenever parallax SS doesnt pick a random layer to display
author: SmArtKar

changes.text: Fixed parallax runtiming horribly whenever parallax SS doesnt pick a random layer to display

title: Admins can actually ban from recovered crew, blood worm, fugitive(/hunter), paradox clone, monkey helmet, glitch
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: Admins can ban from "recovered crew", "blood worm", "fugitive" / "fugitive hunter", "glitch", and "paradox clone"
Mind Magnification Monkeys are now affected by a sentience ban (previously unbannable)

title: integrated circuit shells are no longer doomed to explode
author: Hatterhat

changes.text: Integrated circuit shells now only explode if they draw too much power in a minute, rather than being doomed to explode if it uses too much power over its entire lifetime, following complaints from at least one guy. Nanotrasen representatives claim that this is entirely unrelated to missing shipments of explosive alloys.

title: Blood Worms can drag themselves onto corpses to infest them
author: Jacquerel

changes.text: Blood worms can drag themselves onto corpses to infest them as an alternative to pressing the action button.

title: Dramatically reduces upgraded exoscanner power draw
author: Hatterhat

changes.text: Upgraded exoscanners no longer have skyrocketing power draw when upgraded, following an incident where a station's chief engineer declared vendetta upon their Cargo department for drawing an excessive amount of power, resulting in massive casualties.

title: Fixes 2 instances of turf changing not affecting mounted objects correctly
author: SyncIt21

changes.text: Any effect that changes the theme of the environment no longer break turf mounted objects
destroying plating with lava/water etc will destroy any object mounted to it

title: Nugget Box Resprite + Nuggets/Wings/Fries Containers
author: Twaticus

changes.text: resprites chicken nugget box and adds 3 new food related containers, new nugget box, a wing bucket, and a fry sleeve.

title: Fixes ethereal revive and species change
author: Time-Green

changes.text: Ethereal crystal revive no longer breaks if you change species midway through

title: Fixes multiple objects calling examine() instead of examinate()
author: SmArtKar

changes.text: Fixes press badges and other miscellaneous objects failing to make the user examine them.

title: Fixes firebreath obj effects 3 years later
author: Tsar-Salat

changes.text: firebreath will light objects on fire more consistently

title: fixes cyborg emagging not making them unconscious
author: TheRyeGuyWhoWillNowDie

changes.text: cyborgs are made properly unconscious when emagged

title: TGUIfies some VV actions, replaces the actions dropdown with a searchable one
author: SmArtKar

changes.text: Some non-critical VV actions such as mutation/organ/quirk modification have been converted to TGUI
VV dropdown has gotten a refresh and now boasts a brand-new searchbar

title: Fix jammer bricking headsets
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: Radio jammers no longer brick headsets forever

title: Fixes incorrect usage of world.view or viewers() in some places
author: SmArtKar

changes.text: Fixed z-transition mirages not mirroring all objects on the other z level

title: Fixes mech energy guns draining 100x less than intended.
author: KingkumaArt

changes.text: Fixes mech energy guns draining 100x less than intended.

title: Cytology organs can mutate again
author: Time-Green

changes.text: Coroner cytology grown organs can mutate again
